subsystems.name: store-state-and-ssr
subsystems.note: Codemap cannot follow the request-scope boundary from @aihu/context into the store registry, or the serialized state channel from server snapshots into later client store instantiation, because those contracts cross package and runtime boundaries.

subsystems.name: published-package-boundary
subsystems.note: Codemap cannot resolve whether package metadata and release checks describe an installable tarball, so the export and dependency contract is verified by the pack check and release workflow.
